Purpose: Estimate arm-level respiratory-event proportions and export summaries

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
rm(list=ls())

library(haven)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(rlang)
library(writexl)

library(meta)
library(metafor)
```



# Load data

```{r load_data, echo=FALSE}
datapath <- paste0(here(),"/data_sas/")

dat_rct_include<- read_sas(paste0(datapath, "study_kq1_rct_include.sas7bdat"))
dat_include <- read_sas(paste0(datapath, "study_kq1_include.sas7bdat"))
dat_inc_arm <- read_sas(paste0(datapath, "study_kq1_inc_arms.sas7bdat"))
dat_inc_outcome_l <- read_sas(paste0(datapath, "kq1_inc_rct_results_l_arms_ndsty.sas7bdat"))
```

## Subdata for diabetes and weight loss
```{r}
dat_inc_outcome_dm <- read_sas(paste0(datapath, "kq1_inc_rct_results_l_arms_dm.sas7bdat"))
dat_inc_outcome_wgt <- read_sas(paste0(datapath, "kq1_inc_rct_results_l_arms_wgt.sas7bdat"))
```

## Subdata for GLP-1Ra
```{r echo=FALSE}
dat_inc_outcome_glp <- dat_inc_outcome_l %>%
  mutate(
    drug_group2 = case_when(
      drug_group0  %in% c("Liraglutide", "Semaglutide", "Tirzepatide") ~ "GLP-1Ra",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

```

# Function for summarizing MA results
```{r}
meta_analysis_summary <- function(data, drug_group_var, drug_group, pscale = 100, safe_drug_name = NULL) {
  library(dplyr)
  library(meta)

  # Dynamically specify the drug group variable
  drug_group_filter <- sym(drug_group_var)

  # Get unique ae_term and time_frame values
  ae_terms <- unique(data$outcome_l2)
  time_frames <- unique(data$timec2)

  # Initialize results dataframe
  results <- data.frame(ae_term = character(),
                         time_frame = character(),
                         proportion = numeric(),
                         ci_lower = numeric(),
                         ci_upper = numeric(),
                         num_studies = integer(),
                         effect_ci = character(),
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  # Loop through all combinations of ae_term and time_frame
  for (ae_term in ae_terms) {
    for (time_frame in time_frames) {
      
      # Filter data
      filtered_data <- data %>%
        filter(!!drug_group_filter == drug_group & 
                 outcome_l2 == ae_term & 
                 timec2 == time_frame)
      
      # Check if there are any rows for this combination
      if (nrow(filtered_data) == 0) next
      
      # Run meta-analysis
      # REVIEW R09: Errors are silently skipped; check omitted combinations in the original environment.
      pes.summary <- tryCatch({
        metaprop(events, total_n, study, data = filtered_data, 
                 sm = "PFT", method.tau = "DL", method.ci = "NAsm")
      }, error = function(e) return(NULL))

      if (is.null(pes.summary)) next
      
      # Perform PFT backtransformation
      n_mean <- 1 / mean(1 / filtered_data$total_n)
      proportion <- meta:::backtransf(pes.summary$TE.random, sm = "PFT", n = n_mean) * pscale
      tot_arm_sample_size <- sum(filtered_data$total_n)
      # Conditionally calculate confidence intervals only if more than one study
      if (pes.summary$k > 1) {
        ci_lower <- meta:::backtransf(pes.summary$lower.random, sm = "PFT", n = n_mean) * pscale
        ci_upper <- meta:::backtransf(pes.summary$upper.random, sm = "PFT", n = n_mean) * pscale
      } else {
        ci_lower <- NA
        ci_upper <- NA
      }
      
      # Create effect size summary
      if (pes.summary$k == 1) {
        # Only one study — no CI
        effect_ci <- if (proportion > 0 && proportion < 0.1) {
          "<0.1"
        } else {
          as.character(round(proportion, 1))
        }
      } else {
        # Multiple studies — include CI
        if (proportion > 0 && proportion < 0.1) {
          effect_ci <- paste0("<0.1 (", round(ci_lower,1), ", ", round(ci_upper,1), ")")
        } else {
          effect_ci <- paste0(round(proportion,1), " (", round(ci_lower,1), ", ", round(ci_upper,1), ")")
        }
      }

      
      # Append results
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
        ae_term = ae_term,
        time_frame = time_frame,
        proportion = proportion,
        ci_lower = ci_lower,
        ci_upper = ci_upper,
        num_arms = pes.summary$k,
        tot_arm_sample_size = tot_arm_sample_size,
        effect_ci = effect_ci
      ))
    }
  }
  
  # Create filename with drug name (safe for filenames)
  # Set safe_drug_name if not provided
  if (is.null(safe_drug_name)) {
    safe_drug_name <- gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "_", drug_group)
  }
  
  # Save to Excel and RData
  file_name <- paste0("data/03_percMA_wSumm_", safe_drug_name, ".csv")
  write.csv(results, file_name)
  
  rdata_file_name <- paste0("data/03_percMA_wSumm_", safe_drug_name, ".RData")
  save(results, file = rdata_file_name)

  return(results)

} 

```

# Run meta-analysis and summarize results

## Liraglutide

### Total
```{r}
summary_results_lira_tot <- meta_analysis_summary(dat_inc_outcome_l, "drug_group0", "Liraglutide")
```

### By drug/dose
```{r}
summary_results_lira_tot12 <- meta_analysis_summary(dat_inc_outcome_l, "drug_group1", "Liraglutide 1.2 mg")
summary_results_lira_tot18 <- meta_analysis_summary(dat_inc_outcome_l, "drug_group1", "Liraglutide 1.8 mg")
summary_results_lira_tot30 <- meta_analysis_summary(dat_inc_outcome_l, "drug_group1", "Liraglutide 3.0 mg")
summary_results_lira_totOt <- meta_analysis_summary(dat_inc_outcome_l, "drug_group1", "Liraglutide Other")
```

### Diabetes subset

```{r}
table(dat_inc_outcome_dm$drug_group1)
```

```{r}
# REVIEW R03: These four DM-labelled dose calls use the full dataset.
```
